topic: Missing dwell time data for February 29th
summary_markdown: A discussion arose regarding a gap in the reported dwell time analytics, specifically for February 29th. It was determined that this data point is missing because no calculations were run on the beta environment for that specific date. The issue was attributed to copying a dataset covering all of February 2024, which naturally excluded the necessary data for February 29th.
decisions: The gap in dwell time analytics for February 29th is due to missing source data.
action_items: Run a standard calculation specifically for February 29th to populate the missing dwell time data.
